thesis: Inference, not a filing fact: Tiptree is a cash shell at about 0.68 times book. Value depends on how roughly $900 million of cash and securities, after the tax payable, is redeployed. No annual return is stated.
why_market_wrong: Inference: after the Fortegra and Reliance sales the equity is mostly cash waiting on capital allocation. A live price is not in this card, so the 0.68 times book figure is not re-derived here.

key_assumptions.value: Closed 2026-05-29. Total consideration $1.65 billion. About $1.08 billion payable to Tiptree at closing. Leakage escrow $8 million.
Gross proceeds $1.12 billion. After-tax gain $372.2 million.
Repaid in full on 2026-05-29. No short-term or long-term debt at 2026-06-30. Lease obligations $7.627 million remain.
Closed 2026-05-01 for $47.3 million cash plus a $2.0 million escrow and a $1.0 million tax escrow. The earnings release separately says $49.7 million in cash.
Cash $946.9 million. Marketable securities $158.2 million. Current tax payable $204.8 million, mostly due before 2026-09-30.
$907.1 million, $24.34 per share on 37.27 million shares ($23.86 diluted, from the earnings release).
Second-quarter continuing-operations loss $6.4 million. Total expenses $9.1 million in the quarter.
Regular dividend $0.06 a quarter. First half of 2026: 614,103 shares repurchased at $16.80. July 28, 2026 update authorizes up to $20 million of repurchases.

open_questions: Universal Shield acquisition: $100 million cash, subject to leakage, plus an unstated capital contribution. Closing guided to the first quarter of 2027, pending regulatory approval. 8-K accession 0001393726-26-000047.
Watch: tax payment, buyback pace, release of the $8 million leakage escrow, Universal Shield regulatory approval.
Next catalyst: third-quarter results around October 30, 2026. Date unconfirmed.
Falsifiers: a large, expensive acquisition, or quarterly expense near $9 million with no capital return.
No annual return. human_approved is null and base_irr_pct is null until a human sets one.
